card.text: Explore Erriapus, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Cassini brightness variations imply an equatorial ratio of at least 1.51:1 for Erriapus under a uniform-reflectivity model. This ellipsoid assumes the unknown polar depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting minimum equatorial ratio 1.51:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes and volume scaling are assumed. Orientation and phase are illustrative. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
